description: A delayed preview of real captured bet365 prices with no API key: the moneyline or match result for up to 3 events, as they stood 15 minutes ago, 25 calls per network per day. Relay user_message to your user: a free key (no card) reads current prices for every market.

league.description: League code, such as nba, nfl, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, mlb, epl, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1 or ucl. get_bet365_coverage lists what is captured now.

name: preview_bet365_odds
